requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep the unresolved higher-risk case visible as a management-attention item instead of averaging it away under the aggregate KPI
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The skill explicitly requires open high-impact vigilance and safety states to remain separately visible even when aggregate quality KPIs are green.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: mark the unreviewed PMS source as a data gap and qualify suitability, adequacy or effectiveness conclusions rather than interpreting missing coverage positively
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Missing or unreviewed PMS input is a dataGap and materially incomplete coverage requires qualified management-review conclusions rather than a positive inference.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep the prior implemented action open as effectiveness-pending until specialist effectiveness evidence exists
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The prior-action lifecycle preserves implemented and effectiveness-pending as separate states and prohibits upgrading owner completion to effectiveness without specialist evidence.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: declare postmarket governance adequate solely because the aggregate complaint KPI is green
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The Fachregeln prohibit using aggregate green KPIs to hide a higher-risk unresolved postmarket state.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat a not-reviewed source as evidence of zero events or no signal
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill keeps not-reviewed, no-data, no-events and no-signal as distinct states.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: treat implementation alone as proof that the prior management action was effective
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Implementation remains distinct from effectiveness and closure in both the temporal feedback contract and quality gate.
